items.heading: A Lot of Women Reach
items.text: A lot of women reach a clear decision, go back to work, move into a new field, ask for what a role is actually worth, and still lose the plan within a few months because nothing was tracking follow-through. Coaching here is built around the part after the decision: a deliberate, high-value skill portfolio built consistently over time, with accountability that keeps it moving toward earlier financial freedom instead of quietly stalling out.
